mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 66 degrees near Fireman Park with a lovely Waxing Gibbous moon overhead. Expect the temperature to dip to an overnight low of 55 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

The city has two important updates. First, the Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician to help manage infrastructure projects. Second, residents can now apply for a thirty dollar rain barrel rebate to help manage stormwater runoff on their properties.
There is plenty to do, with live music happening today at Bailey Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. You can also head to the Verona Ice Arena today for the Girls Try Hockey event.
During a notable call on Friday, Verona officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle.
It is the perfect night for a scoop of Caramel Cashew. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to satisfy that sweet tooth.
